grillrengoringssten.title: BBQ Cleaning Stone – Gentle & Effective Cleaning
grillrengoringssten.descriptionHtml:
Keep your BBQ sparkling clean with a BBQ cleaning stone.
The stone easily lifts off burnt-on food residue, grease and grime without damaging your BBQ grates. A perfect alternative to wire brushes and chemicals – natural, effective and easy to use.

  • Effective on burnt-on residue

  • Gentle on the grates – no scratches

  • No chemicals needed

  • Suitable for both charcoal and gas BBQs

A handy little tool for anyone who wants their BBQ cleaned quickly, safely and without the harsh stuff before the next cook-up.

seo.title: BBQ Cleaning Stone | The BBQ Clinic Australia
seo.description: Lift burnt-on grease and grime without scratching your grates. Chemical-free BBQ cleaning stone for charcoal and gas BBQs, from The BBQ Clinic.

hamburgerpress-i-gjutjarn.title: Cast Iron Burger Press – Perfect Burgers Every Time
hamburgerpress-i-gjutjarn.descriptionHtml:
Take your burgers to the next level with our rock-solid cast iron burger press!
Perfect for shaping classic burgers or pressing out seriously crispy, flavour-packed smash burgers right on the BBQ or flat top.

The heavy cast iron delivers even pressure and helps build beautiful caramelisation on the surface, just like at a restaurant.

Features:

  • Made from solid cast iron – built to last

  • Perfect for both classic burgers & smash burgers

  • Even pressure for a crispy sear

  • Suits the BBQ, frying pan and flat top

  • Ergonomic handle for a comfortable grip

Why smash burgers?

Smash burgers are thin, crispy and full of flavour thanks to the intense sear the press creates. With a cast iron press the result is juicier and more flavoursome – a real favourite among burger lovers!

seo.title: Cast Iron Burger Press for the BBQ | The BBQ Clinic
seo.description: Smash burgers done right. Heavy cast iron burger press for even pressure and a crispy sear on the BBQ. BBQ accessories Australia from The BBQ Clinic.
